instruction.text: Below is a table containing some North Yorkshire towns and their population sizes. Rounded to the nearest thousand, which town has a population of 5,000?
Round the population size of the other North Yorkshire towns to the nearest thousand and work out the average total population.

atoms.a: First, round the population size of the remaining towns.
Next, add the rounded sums together.

atoms.b: The total population of the towns rounded to the nearest thousand is 18000.

instruction.text: George has a secret number in his head. It is made up of the following digits: 8, 1, 4 and 6. When rounded to the nearest thousand, the number is 4,000. Select the number that could be George’s secret number.

George has another secret number in his head. It is made up of the following digits: 5, 4, 5 and 6. When rounded to the nearest thousand, the number is 6,000. Select the number that could be George’s number

Joe is going for a run from St Ives to Zennor in Cornwall. The distance is 7081 metres. On the way he stops for a Cornish pasty, and makes a 678 metre detour. He also stops for an ice cream on the way, and makes a 876 metre detour. Work out the total distance Joe has run to the nearest thousand.

atoms.a: First, round the distances of the different parts of his journey.

atoms.a: Next, add the rounded sums together.

atoms.b: The total distance Joe has run to the nearest thousand is 9000m.
